text:
THE PORTRAIT EDIT
ISSUE 02 / THE PROMPT ISSUE
KNITWEAR & LAYERS
122
STUDY 160
Cream Henley & Striped Mini
Rights check
Source: 25069.jpg
IMAGE PROMPT
An original young woman with long, straight brown hair
and blunt bangs stands against a pale backdrop. She
wears a cream ribbed long-sleeve henley with a scoop
neckline, a small embroidered monogram, and two
black stripes across the chest. A black drawstring mini
skirt has contrast white piping at the sides and a
matching embroidered monogram. Thumbhole cuffs
and a thin black choker complete the look. Her
expression is calm and direct. Soft, even studio light.
Palette of cream, black, and white. Crisp and sporty, in
the style of a streetwear athleisure lookbook.
Sporty, crisp, preppy
WORKING NOTES
- The striped henley and piped skirt are the signature
details.
- Keep the monograms simple and generic to avoid
readable text.
Try this: Keep monograms simple and generic.
